headline: MOGOTES ALBOR: 180M AT 0.98% CuEq — SECOND COPPER-GOLD DISCOVERY BESIDE FILO DEL SOL IN VICUÑA DISTRICT (TSXV:MOG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Mogotes Metals Inc.
snippet: Mogotes Metals (TSXV: MOG) announced July 9 that its Albor target — the second copper-gold-silver-molybdenum discovery in an inaugural season at the Filo Sur project in Argentina's Vicuña District — has returned 180 metres at 0.98% copper equivalent, including an 86-metre interval at 0.70% Cu, 0.55 g/t Au and 169 ppm Mo, located immediately south of and along-strike from BHP and Lundin Mining's advancing Filo del Sol discovery. Two separate porphyry-style discoveries in a single inaugural drill season at Filo Sur, within the structural corridor hosting one of South America's most consequential copper-gold systems, signals systematic targeting rather than luck — and positions Mogotes as a potential consolidation target in the district's most active M&A environment.

headline: MINAURUM HITS 1,117 G/T AgEq OVER 5.95M — QUINTERA VEIN GOES DEEPER AS ALAMOS SILVER PROGRAM EXPANDS (TSXV:MGG)
snippet: Minaurum Silver (TSXV: MGG) released July 8 drill results from its 50,000-metre Phase II resource-expansion program at the Alamos Silver Project in Sonora, Mexico, with hole AL26-215 returning 5.95 metres at 1,117 g/t silver equivalent (including 2.40m at 2,557 g/t AgEq) at the Quintera vein zone, while hole AL26-207 at Europa Sur added 3.65m at 888 g/t AgEq (2.65m at 1,053 g/t). At $59/oz silver and with the silver market in its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit, Alamos' back-to-back high-grade intercepts across multiple veins advance the project toward a resource update with credible exploration upside; at 1,000+ g/t in individual holes, this is among the highest-grade active silver drill programs in Mexico.

headline: HONG KONG LAUNCHES "HAU" GOLD CLEARING — 41 INSTITUTIONS JOIN TRIAL LINKED TO SHANGHAI GOLD EXCHANGE
snippet: Hong Kong launched on July 7 the trial operation of a gold central clearing and settlement system backed by 41 participating institutions — banks, mining companies, and jewellers — establishing a "HAU" reference price benchmark and connecting directly to the Shanghai Gold Exchange via a "Delivery Connect" scheme that allows physical gold to flow between Hong Kong's OTC market and mainland China. The launch is the most meaningful institutional challenge to London's LBMA clearing dominance in decades; the HAU benchmark, denominated in HKD and RMB, gives Asian producers and buyers a price reference independent of dollar-denominated LBMA pricing, with direct implications for how output from Asia-Pacific mines is priced, settled, and financed.

headline: 74% OF CENTRAL BANKS PLAN TO CUT DOLLAR RESERVES — GOLD NOW AT CENTER OF GLOBAL RESERVE STRATEGY | Money Metals
snippet: An OMFIF survey published July 7 found that 74% of central bank respondents expect their dollar reserve allocations to be lower within five years, with 82% now holding physical gold (up from 71% a year ago) and 30% planning to increase gold allocations within two years — with respondents describing gold as having moved "to the center of reserve management strategy." The survey lands as monthly central bank purchases are running at approximately 60 tonnes per month through 2026, and the structural divergence between cautious Western investment sentiment and systematic global reserve manager accumulation has become the most consequential supply-demand dynamic in the gold market — one that has prevented sustained breaks below $4,000 despite rising real yields.

headline: WEST RED LAKE GOLD MADSEN: 53.87 G/T AU OVER 3.1M — AUSTIN 904 HIGH-GRADE ZONE INTACT AT 650M DEPTH (TSXV:WRLG)
source_name: GlobeNewswire / West Red Lake Gold Mines
snippet: West Red Lake Gold Mines (TSXV: WRLG) reported July 7 that drilling at the Austin 904 and 955 Complexes at the Madsen Mine in Ontario's Red Lake Mining District has returned 53.87 g/t Au over 3.1m and 43.38 g/t Au over 3.85m from approximately 650 metres depth, alongside a broader 10.22 g/t Au over 13.35m intercept confirming grade continuity across a wide panel of unmined gold. Madsen's Austin zone represents an approximately 200m by 200m panel of historically intact gold mineralization; at these grades and depths, West Red Lake's infill drilling is converting structural grade risk to mining confidence — the critical prerequisite for an underground mine restart decision at one of Canada's most storied historic gold mines.

headline: GROUP ELEVEN BALLYWIRE: 6.9M AT 18.3% Zn+Pb, 86 G/T AG — DEEPER CU-AG ZONE HIT 275M AWAY IN IRELAND (TSXV:ZNG)
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSXV: ZNG) reported July 7 that drilling at the Ballywire discovery in County Galway, Ireland returned 6.9 metres at 18.3% Zn+Pb and 86 g/t Ag in a 50-metre step-out extension hole, and separately intersected a Cu-Ag target at 275 metres beyond the nearest comparable test — hitting 4.7m at 0.88% Cu and 67 g/t Ag — across 83 total holes reported to date at the PG West Project. The results confirm Ballywire is growing in two distinct directions simultaneously: laterally in zinc-lead-silver, and at depth in copper-silver — a structural complexity that increases the probability of a polymetallic VMS system with multiple commodity revenue streams, in the same Irish Midlands belt that produced the Lisheen mine (54Mt at 11% Zn).

headline: ALKANE DRILLS DEEPEST BJÖRKDAL HIT YET: GOLD AT 762M CONFIRMS STORHEDEN OPEN AT DEPTH (ASX:ALK)
snippet: Alkane Resources (ASX: ALK / TSX: ALK) released July 8 near-mine exploration results from 29 new drill holes at the Björkdal Gold Mine in Sweden, with gold confirmed at 762 metres depth — the deepest intersection yet at the operation — as the Storheden deposit's strike and depth extent both continue to grow beyond the current resource outline and producing underground mine workings. On a producing Scandinavian gold operation with world-class infrastructure, permitting certainty, and grid-power access, confirming the ore system is open to 762m of tested depth materially de-risks any future mine life extension study and changes the capital return profile of the operation for years beyond the current plan.

headline: GOLD FALLS TO $4,087 AS US-IRAN AIRSTRIKES CONTINUE — JULY 14 CPI IS THE KEY TO METALS RECOVERY
snippet: Gold opened July 9 at $4,087/oz — down from the July 2 high of $4,155 set after the payrolls miss — as U.S. airstrikes on Iran sent oil surging 5%+ while simultaneously pressuring non-yielding metals, with silver falling to $58.45 as markets repriced stagflation risk higher ahead of the June CPI print due July 14 at 8:30 a.m. ET. With the Fed split 9-to-8 on a 2026 rate hike, the July 14 data point is binary for precious metals: CPI at or above 4.0% likely pushes September rate-hike odds back toward 65% and keeps real yields elevated, while a print below 3.8% compresses those odds and provides the catalyst for both metals to recover the ground lost since the FOMC minutes.

headline: BOFA SLASHES 32 COMMODITY TARGETS BUT KEEPS URANIUM BUY — CAMECO RATED $140, 23% SECTOR UPSIDE VS SPOT
snippet: Bank of America slashed price targets on 32 commodities in its July 2026 review — including 21 in precious metals, five in base metals, four in steel — but maintained uranium as its lone standout conviction buy, keeping Cameco (NYSE: CCJ) rated Buy at a $140 target representing approximately 48% upside, with BofA identifying 23% upside for the spot uranium price as the largest forward gap in its entire coverage universe. Uranium's standalone momentum — driven by AI data center nuclear offtake deals, utility re-contracting after years of underbuying, and constrained new mine supply — makes it the one commodity where structural demand has not been impaired by dollar strength or Fed hawkishness, even as the broader commodity complex absorbs geopolitical oil shocks.

headline: FATHOM NICKEL GOCHAGER LAKE PHASE-2 DONE: NEW Ni-Cu-Co ZONES ACROSS 800M STRIKE, ASSAYS AUGUST (CSE:FNI)
source_name: Investing News Network / Fathom Nickel Inc.
snippet: Fathom Nickel (CSE: FNI) announced July 10 the completion of its 9-hole, 3,174.5-metre Phase-2 drill program at the Gochager Lake Project in northern Saskatchewan's Trans-Hudson Corridor, with samples delivered to the laboratory on July 10 and initial assay results expected in early August — the program identified new zones of nickel-copper-cobalt mineralization across 800 metres of strike length extending both southwest and northeast of the historic Gochager Lake deposit. Saskatchewan's Trans-Hudson Corridor has historically hosted high-grade magmatic nickel-copper-cobalt deposits, and new zone identification across an 800-metre strike extension before assay data arrives is the early indicator that a Phase-3 program is probable; the August assay release is the key de-risk moment for any position sizing decision on this CSE-listed battery metals explorer.

headline: MIATA METALS PUMA EAST: 17.19M AT 3.14 G/T AU — NEW GOLD DISCOVERY 3KM FROM MAIN TREND IN SURINAME (TSXV:MMET)
snippet: Miata Metals (TSXV: MMET) announced July 7 the discovery of a new gold zone at Puma East — approximately 3 kilometres southeast of the Jons Trend-Big Berg Corridor at the Sela Creek Gold Project in Suriname — with hole PL26-001D returning 17.19 metres at 3.14 g/t Au and hole PL26-002D adding 21.64 metres at 1.70 g/t Au, establishing a stand-alone discovery target requiring follow-up drilling in the company's ongoing 25,000-metre program. A new gold zone at 3.14 g/t over 17m in a discovery hole 3 kilometres from the known mineralization corridor confirms Sela Creek's footprint is materially larger than current resource outlines suggest — a development that elevates regional exploration priority and raises the probability that a maiden resource undervalues the project's total endowment.
